mapper.select: SELECT id, template_id, name, coupon_type, coupon_value, min_consume, start_time, end_time, total_quantity, user_max_quantity, issued_quantity, create_time, update_time FROM coupon_template WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coupon_template (template_id, name, coupon_type, coupon_value, min_consume, start_time, end_time, total_quantity, user_max_quantity, issued_quantity, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{name}, #{couponType}, #{couponValue}, #{minConsume}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalQuantity}, #{userMaxQuantity}, #{issuedQuantity}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_template SET issued_quantity = issued_quantity + #{increment}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE template_id = #{templateId}
